title: AnalysisUploadRequest
description: Multipart/form-data contract for POST /v1/jobs/upload. The form includes one binary file part named file. The API validates the original filename extension and byte size, creates an in-memory queued analysis job, and discards uploaded bytes after request handling.

file.description: Binary local audio file. Supported filename extensions are .wav, .mp3, and .flac. The maximum accepted size is 104857600 bytes. Empty files are rejected.
